purpose: Warmed allocation attribution; profiled timings are not performance claims

summary.weightMeaning: Sample weights estimate allocation pressure in bytes; they are not object sizes or exact object counts.
summary.allocationCounterMeaning: Approximate bytes allocated since thread start; deltas span first/last observed counters, not exact JMH iteration edges.
